item.title: Eric Dane, 'Grey's Anatomy' star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became an advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53. His representatives said Dane died from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, known also as Lou Gehrig’s disease, less than a year after he announced his diagnosis. [...]

item.title: 'You are innocent': Judge signs orders formally clearing former suspects in Austin yogurt shop murders
item.description: After spending decades of their lives wrongly accused of one of Austin's most infamous crimes, four men previously believed to have killed four teenage girls at the I Can’t Believe It’s Yogurt! shop on Anderson Lane in 1991 will finally see their names cleared.

item.title: Texas Republicans looking to close primaries for 2028
item.description: More than 6,000 people have voted in the first three days of early voting for the primary elections in Texas, which has open primaries, and the Republican Party of Texas has filed a lawsuit to close the Republican primary, citing the first amendment right of association.

item.title: Early voting locations for Lubbock County March 2026 election
item.description: Early voting for the March primaries in Lubbock County, Texas begins on February 17, 2026, with 22 locations available for voters to cast their ballot.

item.title: Floydada Tech Center renamed Annie Taylor Center
item.description: Annie Taylor, one of the first African American teachers in Floydada, Texas, is being honored with the renaming of the Floydada Technology Center to the Annie Taylor Center for Continuing Education, in recognition of her pioneering efforts to integrate the local college and her 50 years of teaching service.

item.title: Coach Outlet to open in Lubbock's West End Center
item.description: A new Coach outlet is set to open in Lubbock, Texas at the West End Center. The project is scheduled to begin on May 4, 2026, and aims to be completed by July 31, 2026, with an estimated cost of $720,000.
